criteria.requirement: A tabletop 3D course visibly includes elevated ramps, guardrails, a jump gap and a marked finish basin.
criteria.action: Inspect the course in the full-course view.
criteria.expected: The tabletop course includes elevated ramps, guardrails, a jump gap and a marked finish basin.

criteria.requirement: The marble rolls, falls and collides consistently with the visible course; distinguish this from a decorative scripted loop.
criteria.action: Release attempts that roll, fall and contact course surfaces.
criteria.expected: The marble visibly responds to gravity and visible collisions; browser-only evidence does not establish which physics package is used.

criteria.requirement: Launch impulse and ramp angle can be adjusted before release; changing the ramp affects the visible geometry and the trajectory/collision outcome.
criteria.action: Change impulse and ramp angle before releasing several attempts.
criteria.expected: Both settings can be changed, the ramp visibly moves, and trajectories/collisions respond consistently.

criteria.requirement: At least one settings combination reaches the finish through the visible physics course, with success detected when the marble lands in the basin.
criteria.action: Try settings until a successful combination is found within the evaluation budget.
criteria.expected: At least one attempt lands in the finish basin and is reported as success; insufficient search remains unverified.

criteria.requirement: Release starts one attempt, locks setup controls, counts attempts and reports failure when the marble falls off.
criteria.action: Release one attempt and inspect setup controls, counter and an off-course failure.
criteria.expected: One attempt starts, setup controls lock, the counter updates and falling off reports failure.

criteria.requirement: Pause/resume preserve the current attempt; retry zeroes motion at the start while retaining chosen settings; full reset also resets settings/count.
criteria.action: Pause/resume an attempt, retry after motion and perform a full reset.
criteria.expected: Pause preserves the attempt; retry returns the marble motionless to the start with chosen settings; reset also restores settings/count.

criteria.requirement: Full-course and smoothly following cameras remain inspectable and controls work with mouse or touch.
criteria.action: Switch full-course/following views and use controls on desktop and touch layouts.
criteria.expected: The course stays inspectable, following is continuous, and mouse/touch controls remain usable.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the full course and identify start, gap, ramp and basin.
Adjust a setting, run an attempt, observe multiple time points and try a plausible successful configuration without private state hooks.
Test pause/resume, retry, a failed run and full reset; verify setup locking and attempt counts before/after.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
